polaris: 把 La4Ni3O10 的 Ni dz2 层间通道从 DW 重构断路态，工程化切换成可承载 bulk superconductivity 的层间相位总线。
framework: 分布式共识 / quorum sensing / 容错总线。每个 NiO2 层或局域配对斑块不是自动形成三维超导，而是必须通过 dz2-pz-dz2 通道广播相位。bulk SC 对应相位投票达到 quorum；static DW 是 bus partition，DW fluctuations 可以仍是 local pairing noise/glue。

math_object.borrowed_structure: distributed consensus with lossy inter-node communication plus percolation threshold
math_object.physical_translation: 局域配对振幅对应节点内 order parameter；dz2-mediated interlayer spectral weight 对应跨层消息带宽；static DW reconstruction 对应丢包/分区；bulk Meissner fraction 和 c-axis Josephson-like response 对应全局共识达成。
math_object.control_variable: Q_phi, the interlayer phase quorum score
math_object.units: W_z2(0,Omega_c) is an energy-integrated c-axis dz2/pz spectral-weight proxy normalized to eV; C_phi is dimensionless phase-connectivity factor from layer-resolved structural/orbital coherence; Gamma_phi is an angular-frequency dephasing rate in s^-1, so hbar*Gamma_phi is energy. Q_phi is dimensionless.
math_object.threshold_statement: bulk superconductivity requires Q_phi > Q_c while local pairing only requires a finite in-plane gap/fluctuation scale. Q_c is material- and disorder-dependent and must be calibrated by Meissner/shielding fraction, not by rho_c/rho_ab.

t_perp_eff_units.convention: Use omega_perp_eff in s^-1 when writing rates, and E_perp_eff = hbar*omega_perp_eff in eV or meV when entering dimensionless ratios.
t_perp_eff_units.forbidden_shortcut: Do not write hbar*t_perp_eff unless t_perp_eff is explicitly an angular frequency. If t_perp_eff is an energy from band fitting, use t_perp_eff/(k_B*T + hbar*Gamma).

epsilon_c_sign.definition: epsilon_c = -(c - c0)/c0, so c-axis compression is positive and c-axis expansion is negative.
epsilon_c_sign.implication: A positive partial derivative dQ_phi/d epsilon_c means c-axis compression improves the phase bus, but this must be separated from pressure-driven bandwidth, carrier density, and disorder changes.

avoid_lambda_circularity.input_side: Infer Q_phi/Lambda from c-axis optical Drude weight, polarization-resolved O K-edge/Ni L-edge dz2-pz spectral weight, ARPES kz dispersion, RIXS/ultrafast dephasing, or DFT/DMFT orbital-resolved hopping.
avoid_lambda_circularity.validation_side: Use rho_c/rho_ab only as a secondary transport consequence, not as both definition and proof. Primary validation is onset of bulk diamagnetic shielding, c-axis Josephson plasma/THz response, pressure optical spectral-weight recovery, and phase stiffness.

alternative_explanations.name: pressure bandwidth effect
alternative_explanations.risk: Pressure can raise Tc by broadening bands or changing correlations without a dz2 phase-bus mechanism.
alternative_explanations.separation_test: At fixed or comparable in-plane bandwidth proxy, test whether c-axis dz2 spectral weight or kz dispersion predicts shielding fraction/Tc better than ab-plane Drude weight.

alternative_explanations.name: scattering anisotropy and structural domains
alternative_explanations.risk: rho_c/rho_ab can change because tau_c/tau_ab or domain populations change, not because coherent hopping is restored.
alternative_explanations.separation_test: Compare optical sum-rule spectral weight and Hall/magnetoresistance scattering rates; require domain imaging or single-domain strain geometry.

alternative_explanations.name: common third variable
alternative_explanations.risk: oxygen stoichiometry, carrier density, disorder, or structural phase fraction can tune both interlayer coherence and superconductivity.
alternative_explanations.separation_test: Use two-axis tuning, e.g. chemical stoichiometry for carrier density plus uniaxial strain for dz2 overlap, and seek crossed trajectories with same carrier density but different Q_phi.

findings: Round 2 的突破不是声称 interlayer coherence 首创，而是把 dz2-mediated interlayer coherence 从描述性组织参数改写为可工程化的相位总线变量 Q_phi。目标窗口是：保留 DW fluctuations/local pairing，削弱 static DW 对 dz2-pz-dz2 通道的分区效应，使 c-axis phase stiffness 先于或同步于 bulk shielding 恢复。La4Ni3O10 的新杠杆在 trilayer 内部：inner/outer Ni 层之间的 dz2 通道是否能被压力、单轴应变、氧/稀土化学压力或非平衡泵浦选择性重接。
strangest_prediction: 如果相位总线图像成立，会出现一种看似反直觉窗口：static DW peak 或 DW gap 不必完全消失，甚至局域 pairing/fluctuation 指标仍强，但只要 dz2-pz-dz2 c-axis spectral weight 和 phase stiffness 跨过 Q_c，就能出现 bulk shielding；反之，单纯削弱 DW 振幅但没有恢复 dz2 c-axis spectral weight，只会得到金属性改善或二维/丝状超导。

technology_routes.route: hydrostatic pressure plus in-situ c-axis optical/THz spectroscopy on La4Ni3O10 single crystals
technology_routes.control_knob: Pressure P; treat P as multi-variable and track structural, bandwidth, and carrier proxies separately.
observables: c-axis low-frequency Drude spectral weight Delta W_c(P,T)
THz Josephson-like plasma edge or phase-stiffness onset
bulk shielding fraction and resistive Tc under the same pressure path
DW gap amplitude from ultrafast/optical spectroscopy
ab-plane Drude weight as bandwidth control
technology_routes.success_criterion: Delta W_c or THz phase stiffness shows a precursor recovery before or at bulk shielding onset, while ab-plane Drude weight alone does not predict the transition. Static DW signatures may weaken but need not vanish.
technology_routes.failure_criterion: Tc and shielding track only ab-plane bandwidth or structural transition, with no selective c-axis spectral-weight recovery beyond scattering-rate changes.

technology_routes.route: uniaxial strain device: independently tune epsilon_c and in-plane strain in thin lamella or film-like La4Ni3O10
technology_routes.control_knob: epsilon_c = -(c-c0)/c0; compression is positive. Compare positive epsilon_c with matched in-plane strain states.
observables: polarization-resolved O K-edge XAS pz pre-edge weight
c-axis optical spectral weight or vertical tunneling conductance
DW peak intensity/domain population by x-ray scattering
technology_routes.success_criterion: At comparable carrier density and disorder, positive epsilon_c increases dz2/pz spectral weight and shielding fraction more strongly than it changes in-plane transport. Domain-controlled samples collapse onto Q_phi rather than rho_c/rho_ab.
technology_routes.failure_criterion: Effects are dominated by structural domain switching or cracks/contact geometry; Q_phi proxies do not correlate with shielding once domains are controlled.

technology_routes.control_knob: Rare-earth substitution or isovalent chemical pressure to tune dz2 overlap, combined with oxygen control to tune carrier density/disorder separately.
observables: oxygen stoichiometry by EELS or neutron refinement
RIXS static SDW peak and damping of spin excitations
bulk shielding fraction rather than only zero resistance
technology_routes.success_criterion: Samples with similar Hall number but larger pz/dz2 coherent weight show larger shielding/Tc; both oxygen-vacancy localization and oxygen-interstitial overdoping are avoided.
technology_routes.failure_criterion: All apparent improvements collapse onto carrier density, disorder, or phase fraction, with no independent dz2-channel leverage.

technology_routes.route: non-equilibrium mid-IR pump of apical oxygen / dz2-pz-dz2 coordinate
technology_routes.control_knob: Pump fluence and frequency resonant with apical oxygen or c-axis polar mode, below damage threshold.
observables: recovery times of dz2 spectral weight versus DW amplitude
technology_routes.success_criterion: A transient c-axis phase-stiffness signal appears in a time window where local pairing signatures survive and before thermal structural relaxation dominates.
technology_routes.failure_criterion: Only heating-like DW melting or normal-state conductivity enhancement appears, with no phase-stiffness-specific response.

claims.statement: dz2-mediated interlayer phase quorum can be treated as a tunable design variable rather than a passive diagnostic.
assumptions: W_z2 can be isolated or bounded by c-axis optical/XAS/ARPES proxies.
Bulk shielding fraction is a valid external calibration of phase quorum.
Local pairing signatures can survive partial static DW suppression.

claims.statement: The most valuable La4Ni3O10 experiment is not pressure-Tc mapping alone, but pressure or strain mapping of the temporal order: dz2/c-axis spectral recovery versus bulk shielding onset versus DW weakening.
equations: causal order test: recovery(W_z2 or rho_s,c) <= onset(bulk shielding) is required; disappearance(DW) is not required
assumptions: Pressure optical or THz data can be obtained with enough low-frequency resolution.
Shielding fraction is measured, not inferred from zero resistance alone.

claims.statement: rho_c/rho_ab is useful only as a downstream symptom; using it to define and then verify Lambda is circular.
equations: Lambda_input != f(rho_c/rho_ab) when rho_c/rho_ab is used as validation
assumptions: Scattering anisotropy and domain effects can be independently constrained.

a_objection: A 博士最可能反对：Q_phi 太工程化，W_z2/C_phi/Gamma_phi 的分解依赖代理量，且压力下多变量纠缠会让因果链过拟合。回应是：本轮不把 Q_phi 当精确微观哈密顿量参数，而当设计变量和实验分流器；只接受由光谱/THz/ARPES/RIXS输入、由 shielding/phase stiffness 输出的非循环判据。
failed_jumps: 经济学市场清算类比失败：能描述多变量均衡，但无法给出 dz2 通道的可观测量或单位约束。
音乐和声类比失败：相位锁定直观，但缺少可校准阈值和替代解释分离能力。

deepening.level_1: distributed consensus: local nodes need enough interlayer messages to form a global phase decision.
deepening.level_2: Byzantine/partition-tolerant consensus: static DW creates layer partitions or corrupted links; fluctuations are not necessarily fatal because dynamic noise can coexist with consensus if link capacity exceeds dephasing.
deepening.physics_payoff: This maps directly to the design rule: increase dz2-pz-dz2 message capacity or reduce phase dephasing without necessarily eliminating all DW fluctuations.

next_plan: 下一轮应要求 A/B 都围绕同一组非循环实验量收敛：W_z2/c-axis Drude or THz stiffness as input, shielding fraction as output, Hall/ab Drude/domain imaging as controls. B 的下一步可专攻器件化 strain/vertical tunneling geometry，把 Q_phi 从概念变成实验反馈回路。
literature_needed: La4Ni3O10 pressure optical conductivity c-axis Drude weight
La4Ni3O10 ultrafast density wave pressure superconductivity
trilayer nickelate uniaxial strain dz2 orbital XAS
RP nickelate apical oxygen pump THz Josephson plasma

inspectable_predictions.prediction: At fixed Hall density, Q_phi proxies predict shielding fraction better than DW peak amplitude.
inspectable_predictions.observable_floor: Need shielding fraction and a dz2/c-axis spectral proxy on the same sample series.

inspectable_predictions.prediction: Positive epsilon_c should improve Q_phi only if it enhances dz2-pz-dz2 overlap; a pure bandwidth increase without c-axis spectral recovery should not yield robust bulk shielding.
inspectable_predictions.observable_floor: Need independent ab-plane bandwidth proxy and c-axis orbital/spectral proxy.

inspector_check.formula: Q_phi = W_z2(0,Omega_c) * C_phi / (k_B*T + hbar*Gamma_phi), with W_z2 in eV after normalization, Gamma_phi in s^-1, hbar*Gamma_phi in eV, C_phi dimensionless, Q_phi dimensionless. epsilon_c = -(c-c0)/c0, compression positive.
inspector_check.direction: Increase Q_phi by restoring dz2-pz-dz2 c-axis spectral weight or reducing phase dephasing; validate by bulk phase stiffness/shielding, not by reusing rho_c/rho_ab.
inspector_check.data: Inputs are pi_round1_synthesis.md, known inspector warnings, research plan, AHA record, arXiv:2605.18524, and arXiv:2604.14701.
inspector_check.assumptions: Spectroscopic dz2/c-axis proxies can be measured under pressure/strain or transferred across controlled sample series; pressure effects can be decomposed by bandwidth, scattering/domain, and third-variable controls.
